title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Solo #18 (가로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Romanian woman, an adult, in her early 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real pores, real living eyes, 15 drop dangles piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing a single piece of silver a hair ornament. Full body painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 28% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with floral medallion border filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with fine filigree linework filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
